=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.py:93-97 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: README_NOT_REPOSITORY_VARIABLES lost the GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED exclusion when it moved out of tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py, so discover_switches adds it to the merged registry as a phantom switch.
  WHY: GitHub rejects repository variable names that start with GITHUB_, and README.md:488 still lists the row as default true. Severity disagreement: the sources rated it NIT and MAJOR, and the highest is kept.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:54-58 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new root check warns only when .github/workflows is missing. It does not warn when README.md is missing, so README-only switch discovery is silently skipped.
  WHY: _readme_variables_rows catches OSError/UnicodeDecodeError and returns {} with no operator-visible signal. This was a hardening suggestion with risk score 1, not a defect. The severity and confidence values were assigned during consolidation, not stated by the reviewers.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: GitHub rejects variable names that start with GITHUB_. README.md:488 still lists the row as default true. The fix is to restore the entry with its original reason string.

- scripts/stage_switch_watch.py:93-97 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED exclusion is missing from README_NOT_REPOSITORY_VARIABLES.
  WHY: The scanner discovers this variable from the README and adds it to the merged registry, although it is not a repository variable. This regresses the behavior of the previous test suite.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Exclude README_NOT_REPOSITORY_VARIABLES (each with its reason string), keeping non-repo-variable default-on README rows out of discovery
  Expected change site: scripts/stage_switch_watch.py README_NOT_REPOSITORY_VARIABLES (lines 93-97)

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:56-58 | hardening suggestion, risk score 1
  PROBLEM: The new elif catches only a missing .github/workflows directory. A STAGE_SWITCH_REPO_ROOT that has a workflows directory but no README.md silently loses README-only switch discovery.
  WHY: _readme_variables_rows returns {} on OSError/UnicodeDecodeError (scripts/stage_switch_watch.py:193-198) with no signal. The suggested fix is a parallel elif that warns when README.md is not a regular file (about 3 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  WHY: An override pointing at a root with workflows but no README silently omits README-only switches. The suggested fix is to also warn when README.md is not a file (about 3 lines).
